'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Bill Kafer LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
